set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O04.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with institutional data steward
Scope: Apply and qualify the institution’s actual retention/hold/backup-expiry/erasure or exclusion decisions using H03.2’s engineering mechanics; local synthetic policies do not close this task.

Work kind: mixed
Acceptance gate: O04 (bd-01M4W40KFJVWZAM6RZ8DDH4P2D)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inventory references from releases, staging, derivatives, shared blobs and backups; never remove a blob still required by an allowed retained reference.
2. Implement the selected retention/hold/backup-expiry policy and operator status/reporting; automatic GC remains disabled unless its races are separately qualified.
3. For a required physical-erasure case, prove the procedure across live and backup copies or block admission of that data class; logical withdrawal alone is never labeled physical deletion.

Verification: Reachability and shared-content fixtures, backup-expiry checks, and a data-steward-approved erasure or exclusion procedure.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O04.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional retention and erasure requirements

Source/contracts:
- docs/prd.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O04.1: bd-01M4W5P9WHJFTH2K179GXKEFW3
- O03.3: bd-01M4W5P9ESGWRSDE5HEY3WY7XX
- SITE01.2: bd-01M4W5P46THC7WFA4FD0B1A68Z
- H03.2: bd-01M4X8MAJJN8C3ZKDHM164G25X

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O04.2: Implement retention accounting and the required erasure boundary
